title: calochortus elegans var. selwayensis
intro: Calochortus elegans var. selwayensis, commonly known as the Selway mariposa lily, is a perennial plant species in the family Liliaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calochortus elegans var. selwayensis include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal activities, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, further research is needed to confirm the effectiveness and safety of using Calochortus elegans var. selwayensis for medicinal purposes.
